name: witness
title: witness
blurb: a plain-html public ledger for the receipts, the potholes, whatever else a community wants on the record — link the scanned original, no login to browse, and repeat pothole reports on the same spot tally up instead of disappearing. every entry has its own permalink page with a print button, so a witnessed entry can be taped to a door as well as linked. off a thread by @howard-beale.fromthewestmeadow.com daring someone to build it; @fromthewestmeadow.com tagged the bot.
